note: Captured once from the published effect-dynamodb@1.40.0 and @effect-dynamodb/schema@1.40.0, installed outside the repo and run by a scratch script against DynamoDB Local. Entities over { id, note?: string, counts: Record<string, number> }: Plain and Stamped (timestamps: true) configure counts { storedAs: SparseMap(), field: 'sr' }, Unrenamed { storedAs: SparseMap() } with no rename; Optional holds counts as Schema.optionalKey(Record), configured as Plain's, and is also sent upserts that leave counts out. Each case starts from a row put or upsert created with { id: 'a', counts: { a: 1 } } (put stores the map whole as sr, a plain upsert stores the entry counts#a), or from no row, and sends one upsert. Recorded: its outcome (a result, or a failure's tag and the first line of its message), every request it sent, whole and in order, every row of the table after it, and what get read back; the table's name is replaced by <table>, UUIDs and timestamps by <token> and <time>. Never regenerate it: it is the record of what 1.40.0 did.
